summary: Lookout southwest of Remer, Cass County: the Cass County tower report gives an 81-foot ladder tower, likely moved when the 1938 second tower went up. FFLA lists it gone.

facts.status_note: Gone from the original site; the report says it was likely moved to a site it calls Blueberry

events.note: Report says the first tower was likely moved to the Blueberry site when the second Remer tower was built in 1938. The year is inferred from the second tower's date.

notes_for_editor: Only one substantive source (the Cass County report, a Wikimedia Commons PDF). The report gives no construction date for the first tower, so none is stated. Height conflict: the table says 81 feet, a 1934 survey note in the same entry says 94 feet. The 'likely moved' to Blueberry is hedged in the source and the report does not describe Blueberry; a human may want to check whether the record's status 'gone' should change to a relocated status once that site is verified. The record's coordinates match the report's GPS for the first Remer tower (47.0418, -93.9861). The second Remer lookout (FFLA 'Remer', 47.03031, -94.03339) is a separate entry and is not covered here.
